s.note: the turtles' home in the sewers
s.how: Roll 500g pizza dough into a rectangle, spread with 125ml pizza sauce and scatter with 150g mozzarella and 80g sliced pepperoni. Roll up from the long side, cut into 12 rolls, sit in a lined tin and bake at 200C for 20 minutes.

Mash 3 avocados with lime juice, chopped coriander, a chopped green chilli and salt. Cut the top off a cob loaf and hollow it out, then spoon the guacamole in so it looks like a turtle shell. Serve with corn chips and the torn bread.

m.how: Stretch pizza dough thin on a floured tray. Spread with pizza sauce, scatter with grated mozzarella, pepperoni and a pinch of oregano. Bake on a very hot tray at 250C for 10 minutes. Cut into big slices and fold each in half to eat.

w.note: the green ooze that made the turtles
w.how: Beat 125g butter with 150g sugar, then 2 eggs, then fold in 200g self-raising flour and 125ml milk. Bake at 175C for 18 minutes and cool. Beat butter, icing sugar and green colouring until soft and spoon on top so it drips down the sides like ooze.

d.how: Peel 6 ripe kiwi fruit and put in a blender with the juice of 3 limes, 500ml cold apple juice, a handful of mint leaves and 3 tbsp honey. Blend until smooth, then add 3 cups of ice and blend again until thick and slushy. Pour into 4 glasses and top each with a kiwi slice and a mint sprig. Serve with wide straws.
